tour.title: Project Foundation & Ingress Security
tour.description: DataShuddi begins at Node 0 (Security Sanitizer). All incoming documents cross a pre-ingestion trust boundary where prompt injection patterns are stripped and untrusted text is wrapped in [UNTRUSTED_CONTENT].

tour.title: Text Extraction with Optical Density Fallback
tour.description: Node 1 handles digital PDFs, Word documents, and text files using PyMuPDF. If char density falls below 50 chars/page, it seamlessly engages the PaddleOCR CPU fallback.

tour.title: Header & Footer Noise Stripping
tour.description: Node 2 uses line frequency analysis across pages to detect repeated running headers, footers, and confidential disclaimers, eliminating semantic dilution before chunking.

tour.title: Hybrid Dual-Layer PII Detection & Anonymization
tour.description: Nodes 3 & 4 combine Presidio regex/NER with Qwen2.5-coder:3b contextual LLM inference on the GTX 1650 GPU, followed by offset-safe placeholder redaction.

tour.title: Pydantic Schema Validation & Residual Scans
tour.description: Node 5 validates the scrubbed document against strict EnterpriseDoc schemas and performs a post-anonymization residual scan to guarantee zero PII leakage.

tour.title: Reflector Self-Correction Loop & Human Escalation
tour.description: Node 6 runs Qwen 14B in CPU mode if validation fails. Governed by a Confidence Gate (≥0.70) and Max Delta Cap (0.05), it adapts thresholds or escalates to human review if retries exceed 3.

tour.title: Zero-Leak Output & Qdrant Vector Upsert
tour.description: Node 7 strictly validates ALLOWED_PAYLOAD_KEYS before generating 1024-dimensional embeddings via mxbai-embed-large and upserting points to Qdrant.

tour.title: State Lifecycle, Persistence & CI/CD Safety Gates
tour.description: The LangGraph StateGraph unifies execution across 4 state tiers, PostgresSaver checkpoints, and passes a 50-doc golden dataset release gate with 100% PII recall.
